texts: The 2021 Winter Olympics were held in Sapporo, Japan. Nestled on the northern island of Hokkaido, Sapporo embraced the Games with its picturesque snowscapes and traditional Japanese hospitality. Athletes and visitors from around the world marveled at the city's seamless blend of modernity and nature, from its bustling streets filled with vibrant, illuminated signage to the tranquil expanses of snow-covered parks and mountains. The opening ceremony was a breathtaking display of culture, featuring state-of-the-art light projections on the snow and a magnificent fireworks display that lit up the crisp winter sky. The cozy, snowbound venues were perfectly equipped to host the exciting array of events, including a new technologically-advanced ice rink specifically constructed for the Olympics.
The Winter Olympics have not been held since 1924, when they were first organized in St. Moritz, Switzerland. The next Winter Olympics will be held in Beijing, China, from January 8 to 25, 2022.

The 2021 Winter Olympics were originally awarded to Beijing in 2015, and were scheduled to take place from February 4 to 20, 2022. However, due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the International Olympic Committee (IOC) and the Beijing Organizing Committee decided to postpone the Games to 2022.

So, the 2021 Winter Olympics were actually held in 2022, in Beijing, China.
